## One Day On Campus Study Abroad Fair

News Date : 21 Aug 2024News ReportDate: 21.08.2024 – Career Guidance Cell (CGC-MGIT)B.Tech V & VII semester students have attended the event held by the Career Guidance Cell in collaboration with Global Education and Careers Forum (GECF) Hyderabad on 21-09-2024 at MGIT. The students are instructed to attend the fair as per the schedule given below in E – Block Seminar Halls (301&302): The time slots have been prepared from 10:00AM to 02:10PM, the interactions of the students at the venues happened.In view of the above, all the HoDs are requested to ensure that the faculty having class work in the above slots and the departmental Faculty co-ordinators of CGC accompany the students to E – Block Seminar Halls (301&302).The event of the fair has been attended by 25 delegates representing various esteemed universities from the USA, UK, Canada, France, Germany and Ireland, led by Mr. Lakshminarayanan of GECF and 600 students have taken part in the program. The fair has been inaugurated by the Principal of MGIT, Dr. G. ChandraMohan Reddy, who addressed the students and encouraged them to explore the various opportunities available for them in different countries and universities. Vice-Principal Dr K. Sudhakar Reddy appreciated the efforts of CGC and GECF for organizing such a beneficial event. The university representatives interacted with the students individually and in groups. They provided information about the courses offered, admission requirements, scholarships, visa procedures, and career prospects in their respective universities and countries. They also distributed brochures, flyers, and other promotional materials to the students.
